Traded: Venture Capital 🦄 on Instagram: "SpaceX, led by billionaire Elon Musk, has filed confidentially for an initial public offering with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, positioning the company for a potential June 2026 listing. The IPO could value the company at over $1.75 trillion following its acquisition of Musk’s AI startup xAI, and raise up to $75 billion, aiming to fund an accelerated Starship launch schedule, space-based AI data centers, and a lunar base. Major banks including Bank of America, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Morgan Stanley are lined up for senior roles in the offering.

Linoré v1 AI Hybrid, supercomputing architecture designed to shatter the current bottlenecks of Large Language Model (LLM) training and inference.As we push toward the next era of intelligence, hardware must evolve beyond traditional limits. Linoré v1 is engineered for unprecedented density and efficiency:The Hybrid Advantage: A unified node architecture blending the raw throughput of GPUs with the hyper-specialized efficiency of ASIC-LLMs.Next-Gen Scale: 64 high-performance semiconductors per node, powered by HBM4 (512 GB) to handle multi-trillion parameter models with ease.The Speed of Light: Integrated Silicon Photonics (Fiber Optics) interconnects, eliminating traditional copper latency for seamless chip-to-chip communication.Sustainable Power: A Zero Waste Energy Model utilizing advanced liquid cooling, achieving an industry-leading PUE.Built for the ecosystem and optimized through Software compatible, Linoré v1 is the engine for the next generation of AI pioneers.The blueprint is ready.
